 This week, STORYTACO and SHOWBOX Corp. launched their Steam store page for their coming K-drama full-motion video adventure title ‘What the K-Drama?!’, with both companies “aiming to deliver a more cinematic and immersive take on interactive K-drama storytelling”. Wishlisting is live with this store page unveiling, and a demo is scheduled to launch on the PC platform in December of this year.
The companies write that one of the project’s biggest highlights are its star-studded cast. Leading the lineup is actress Yubi Lee , joined by fellow actors Young-seo Pyo and SongGyung Lee . Popular influencers Eunji Pyo and Angelina Danilova will also appear alongside So Young Yoo , a former member of K-pop group After School who has since pursued an acting career. 
 Oh no you didn’t! 
 What the K-Drama?! draws inspiration from the makjang genre, known for its outrageous plot twists and heightened melodrama.
Players find themselves suddenly thrust into a K-drama as the secret child of a powerful chaebol family. Caught in a web of succession battles, family secrets, and betrayal, they must make choices that shape their relationships, determine the course of the story, and ultimately decide their fate.
 A STORYTACO representative commented, “Our collaboration with Showbox has allowed us to raise the production quality while placing even greater emphasis on the cast’s performances and the story’s dramatic twists. 
By combining the global appeal of K-dramas with interactive choices that let players shape the story, we hope to deliver a fresh and exciting take on Korean FMV games.”
